title: Pre-race non-odds candidate freeze for the Sapporo and Chukyo cards

proposal_scope.title: Pre-race non-odds candidate freeze for the Sapporo and Chukyo cards
proposal_scope.hypothesis: For all 24 pre-registered races on the 2026-08-02 Sapporo and Chukyo cards, the already-tested research adapter can persist exactly one hash-verified non-odds WIDE_1 candidate packet or deterministic failure packet per race before its registered cutoff, without changing the frozen model or candidate policy.
proposal_scope.null_hypothesis: The two-card extension cannot retain all 24 races without missing targets, late prospective backfill, forbidden market inputs, future source times, probability-mass violations, duplicate writes, unverifiable artifacts, or production and order side effects.
proposal_scope.racing_mechanism: The frozen non-odds Top3-set softmax assigns probability to every valid unordered three-horse set. Coherent WIDE pair marginals are derived by summing all sets containing each pair, and the deterministic maximum marginal with the fixed horse-id tie-break becomes WIDE_1. Extending the target cards changes neither the model nor the selection mechanism.
proposal_scope.target_population: All 24 races on the pre-registered 2026-08-02 Sapporo meeting 1 day 4 and Chukyo meeting 2 day 4 cards. Target identity and schedule were frozen at 2026-08-02T08:48:52+09:00 from the user-supplied DI260802.CSV using only venue, race identity, race number, and scheduled post time. Every race remains in the denominator; a race whose source or persistence time exceeds its registered cutoff is retained as a failure and is never backfilled as prospective evidence.

proposal_scope.data_as_of: Target cards were selected at 2026-08-02T08:48:52+09:00 before the earliest registered cutoff of 2026-08-02T09:25:00+09:00. Only race identity, venue, race number, and scheduled post time were inspected. Preparation remains synthetic-only; no real entry capture or inference is authorized before APPROVED_TO_RUN.

chronological_fold_design.design: A deterministic synthetic two-card preparation suite followed, only after separate run approval, by one pre-registered chronological Grade-R capture over the 24 fixed target races.
chronological_fold_design.ordering: target registration < source receipt <= feature cutoff; candidate generation start <= generation completion <= freeze commit <= persistence acknowledgement <= feature cutoff < any later odds join
chronological_fold_design.target_selection_rule: Both complete 12-race cards were fixed from non-market fields at 08:48:52 JST before the earliest 09:25 JST candidate cutoff.
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No real 2026-08-02 entry page, runner row, historical row, or market row may be read during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE.
chronological_fold_design.late_race_rule: Any race whose source or persistence event occurs after its registered cutoff remains in the ledger with a deterministic failure status and cannot count as prospective evidence.
chronological_fold_design.failure_denominator_rule: Every registered target race remains in the packet ledger; no failure is dropped.
chronological_fold_design.card_isolation_rule: Sapporo and Chukyo use separate configs, input manifests, output roots, and hash chains; pooled completeness is checked only after both card audits pass.

purge_embargo.market_firewall: No odds, popularity, market rank, payout, result, final odds, or derivative may enter target selection, feature calculation, candidate construction, tie-break, or retention.
purge_embargo.post_event_embargo: No source event or label timestamp later than the registered candidate cutoff may be accepted for a candidate-ready row.
purge_embargo.target_selection_embargo: No race may be added, removed, or manually prioritized after target registration or after observing market data.

primary_metric.name: two_card_candidate_freeze_packet_ledger_completeness
primary_metric.baseline: EXP-20260802-007 validated the same candidate-freeze mechanism for the Niigata card only; Sapporo and Chukyo currently have zero registered packets.
primary_metric.evaluation: All 24 pre-registered races, including source, cutoff, feature, universe, probability, persistence, and unavailable failures.

notes: Sapporo and Chukyo candidate-freeze extension; target identity and schedule registered from hash-bound DI260802.CSV without market fields; no real-data execution authorized.
